values.note: City of Menahga: $45 a night plus tax for an electric and water site; the two primitive sites (16 and 18) $30 plus tax. Leaving without paying incurs a $500 skip fee.

fees.source: https://www.cityofmenahga.com/?SEC=7931997F-BBF8-4A2E-8A6F-683D109402C1 ('Rates are $45 per night plus tax', 'There are 2 primitive sites (16 & 18) available at a reduced rate ($30.00 plus tax) with no electric or water', 'IF YOU CAMP AT OUR CAMPGROUND AND LEAVE WITHOUT PAYING YOU WILL BE CHARGED A $500.00 SKIP FEE'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Reserve online (ResNexus) or call City Hall, 218-564-4557; within 10 days of arrival a site can only be secured by phone.

booking.source: https://www.cityofmenahga.com/?SEC=7931997F-BBF8-4A2E-8A6F-683D109402C1 ('Reserve your campsite online or call for assistance', 'IF YOU'RE TRYING TO RESERVE 10 DAYS OR LESS BEFORE RESERVATION DATE, YOU MUST CALL (218-564-4557) TO SECURE A SITE', 'Click here to reserve!' -> resnexus.com), read 2026-11-11

values.note: 22 electric and water sites (1-13, 14A, 14B, 15, 17, 19-23) and two primitive sites (16 and 18). One RV per site.

sites.source: https://www.cityofmenahga.com/ campground map 2025_campground.png (sites 1-13, 14A, 14B, 15, 17, 19-23 marked 'W, E'; 16 and 18 unmarked) + page ('There are two primitive sites (16 & 18), the rest of the sites have electric and water available', 'Only one RV per site'), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: https://www.cityofmenahga.com/?SEC=7931997F-BBF8-4A2E-8A6F-683D109402C1 ('campsites with fire rings, picnic tables, and electric/water hookups'; amperage not stated), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://www.cityofmenahga.com/?SEC=7931997F-BBF8-4A2E-8A6F-683D109402C1 ('a clean shower house with flush toilets and hot showers', 'RV dump station for your convenience (fee applies)'), read 2026-11-11

note: 40-acre wooded City of Menahga campground on the west side of Highway 71; two pavilions, playground, volleyball, horseshoes and a 12-tee disc golf course. The Spirit Lake swimming beach, fishing pier and public boat access are about a quarter mile away. ATVs may drive only to and from their site. --Claude
summary: City page and map read: $45 + tax (W/E), primitive 16/18 $30, 24 sites (22 W/E), online through ResNexus (not RoverPass) or by phone, phone-only within 10 days, shower house with flush toilets, dump (fee). Amperage and season dates not stated. ResNexus engine rendered blank (unread).
